title: 양쪽 어금니 대기
instruction: 혀끝을 왼쪽과 오른쪽 어금니에 번갈아 대세요.
caption: 혀끝을 양쪽 어금니에 번갈아 대세요.
motion_prompt: Move the tongue tip to touch the left back molar area, return to center, then touch the right back molar area and return. Keep the jaw still.
face_animation_policy: 중립·목표·복귀의 얼굴 전체 자세를 먼저 설계한다. 운동에 필요한 턱·볼·입꼬리·턱선을 함께 연동하고 선화·명암·질감을 맞춘다. 정지 얼굴 위에 입 도형만 교체하는 방식은 사용하지 않는다. 혀 독립 운동의 턱 안정은 해당 운동 의도를 따른다.
poses: single tongue resting centrally low, both UPPER and LOWER tooth arches and posterior molars visible
single tongue curves toward VIEWER-LEFT and tongue TIP touches inner surface of LEFT POSTERIOR MOLAR area; keep both arches visible and jaw fixed
single tongue curves toward VIEWER-RIGHT and tongue TIP touches inner surface of RIGHT POSTERIOR MOLAR area; keep both arches visible and jaw fixed
prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Animation keyframe atlas for tongue_10_molars. EXACTLY 1 columns and 3 rows of equal rectangular 16:9 tiles, edge-to-edge, NO gaps, NO borders, NO labels. Overall aspect ratio 16:27. Read tiles row-major left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Each tile contains ONE complete scene, not multiple views. Create a clean non-graphic clinical educational 2D illustration matching the warm cel-shaded palette of the reference. Neutral pale warm background, large isolated mouth anatomy, no extra therapist portrait or inset. Keep the exact SAME oral geometry, camera and scale across all tiles. Distinguish ivory teeth, pink gingiva and hard/soft palate, single pink muscular tongue. Clear natural contact surfaces, no intersection through teeth or roof. No gore, saliva or surgery. This is an illustrative draft for professional review. Stable FRONT/SLIGHTLY TOP-DOWN transparent-cheek oral cutaway that clearly reveals BOTH left and right posterior molars and upper/lower dental arches at once; use this same view in every tile. A sagittal profile cannot show both molar sides, so do not use it. Tile poses: TILE 1: single tongue resting centrally low, both UPPER and LOWER tooth arches and posterior molars visible. TILE 2: single tongue curves toward VIEWER-LEFT and tongue TIP touches inner surface of LEFT POSTERIOR MOLAR area; keep both arches visible and jaw fixed. TILE 3: single tongue curves toward VIEWER-RIGHT and tongue TIP touches inner surface of RIGHT POSTERIOR MOLAR area; keep both arches visible and jaw fixed. Crucial: each pose must differ by the REQUESTED movement, not random expression. One tongue only, no extra teeth, no detached lips, no camera cuts, no text, numbers, arrows, captions, logos, watermark or UI.
